title: Bone
description: One skeletal element. Geometry itself is not hand-authored here — bones carry a local reference frame plus a landmark set; actual 1mm-resolution surface geometry is either imported from a licensed source mesh (see docs/SOURCES.md) or, where unavailable, procedurally lofted from the landmark/cross-section description in engine/geometry.py.

parent_in_kinematic_chain.description: id of the proximal bone this one articulates with in the rig hierarchy (null for the root, e.g. sacrum/pelvis)

landmarks.description: Named bony landmarks (processes, tuberosities, epicondyles, foramina) used as muscle/ligament attachment anchors, nerve/vessel passage points, or frame axis definitions.

kind.description: tendon_pulley marks a groove, retinaculum or sesamoid a tendon is deflected around rather than attached to. It is not an attachment: the muscle passes over it and carries on, and it is what a muscle's attachments.via_points point at.
